verdict.stance: Overweight / Net-Cash Abu Dhabi Strategic Gas Monopoly
verdict.summary: ADNOC Gas generated $5.05bn EBITDA (36.4% margin) and $3.08bn net profit on $13.88bn revenue in 9M26 while maintaining ~$1.18bn net cash. Long-term domestic gas supply contracts and ADNOC parentage anchor fortress credit quality.

positives: Captive domestic UAE gas distribution monopoly + LNG/export upside.
negatives: Export LPG/naphtha price sensitivity (-23% 9M26 revenue YoY).
Large capex/dividend commitments toward Ruwais LNG and domestic gas expansion.
